result:
T-DG5-FE-C3 is finished and left uncommitted for you to integrate, in about 77 minutes. One e2e test failed on a full disk during the touched-page run. It passed when I re-ran its spec on its own, so every required check now exits 0.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-C3-frontend-ux-engineer.md`, with logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-C3-evidence/`.

**What was built.** The remaining record types that take custom fields now show extension fields when a record is created and when it is viewed. Each screen has a Form tools entry for editing. All of it reuses FE-C2's form-framework pieces unchanged.
- **The eleven extension types:** evidence, baseline, value pool, resource plan, funding approval, change request, meeting record, corrective plan, lesson, BAU handover and control are all done.
- **Charter and business case:** done.
- **T01 fill dialog:** done, for a dimension that has no item yet.
- **Not done, with reasons:**
  - **TOM canvas:** has no create form. Its ten cells exist from the start and are only edited, so values are entered through Form tools on each cell.
  - **T06 scorecard:** one save creates one record per criterion, so a single set of create inputs can't map to one record. It stays on Form tools after the score is saved, as FE-C2 left it.
- **Scope 2:** unit tests for the T05 and T06 header question tags now exist in English and Arabic.
- **Scope 3:** D-164 (j) says the `raid.test.tsx` test passed in the W18 verification, so I did not touch it. It also passed in both of my unit runs.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| DG4 historical validation, start and end | exit 0 |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, `pnpm openapi:lint` | each exit 0 |
| `unit-web`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 1609/1609 each (D-164's 1597 plus my 12 new tests) |
| My e2e spec (`fec3-extension-hosts.spec.ts`) | 2/2 passed, English and Arabic |
| e2e specs that open the dialogs I changed (9 specs) | first run 127 passed, 1 failed; rerun of the failing spec 14/14 passed |
| `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, full web e2e | not run, D-164 |

- **The touched-page failure:** `p4-change-phases` test 6 in English stopped with "no space left on device" while closing its browser, after all its assertions had passed. The disk had refilled to 7.2 GB free by the time I checked, and that spec passed on its own straight after.
- **My own spec failed twice before passing.** Both runs were test mistakes, not product defects, and the logs are kept and explained in the handback:
  - The lesson step ran as the Lead, who lacks the lesson-edit permission. It now runs as the Transformation Office user.
  - The T01 step looked for a "Fill in" button. A new transformation already has all six T01 items, so that button never appears. That path is now a unit test.
- **Specs not run:** the other specs that only reach a touched page through navigation are listed in the handback and left for your full run.

**Gaps**
- **Thin test coverage:** only the lesson and business-case screens are proven end to end. The T01 fill path and the handover record view have unit tests. The other hosts share the same code lines and pass typecheck, but have no test of their own.
- **Funding decisions:** these have no version number, so the screen passes version 1, which is what the server assumes for them. If that server rule changes, `funding.tsx` has to follow.

No new contract, dependency, migration or text key was needed, and no existing text was made untrue. Screenshots of my spec are in the evidence folder (English and Arabic, three screens each). In Arabic the lesson dialog shows two extension fields because the English run had already published its own field on the same test server, which is expected.
